addDepositor(address,bool).notice: `core` depositors (hook, locker) can never be removed.

claim(address,address).notice: Sends `feeOwner`'s whole `token` balance to `feeOwner`.         Reverts `Unauthorized` when `selfClaimOnly[feeOwner]` and caller is not `feeOwner`.

claimTo(address,address,address).notice: Fee owner only. Sends the whole balance to `recipient`.

constantsHash().notice: `Constants.hash()` of the build this contract was compiled with.

rescue(address,address,uint256).notice: Sends at most `balance - totalOwed[token]` (stray funds only).

setSelfClaimOnly(bool).notice: Caller sets its own self claim flag.

storeFees(address,address,uint256).notice: Pulls `amount` of `token` from the depositor and credits `feeOwner`.
